entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, that's it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They barely even started?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We seem to be premature spectators.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess this is what people call "jumpin'[n]the gum."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Jumping the gun.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There ain't nothin' to do here—you wanna[n]go grab a bite somewhere?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sorry, I'm considering picking up more[n]art supplies. I have a summer assignment[n]to work on.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Also, the summer festival drained my[n]coffers. Even if I did grab a bite, all I could[n]order would be water and a hot towel.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah... In that case, we probably oughta[n]just call it quits for today.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, isn't that Yoshizawa?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't you think she's acting strange? You[n]know, she did mention something about[n]a meet earlier.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, ain't you guys headed home?
I've got something to do.
Go on ahead without me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Welp, see ya, then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, catch you later.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai!?
What a pleasant surprise.
Kasumi?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Y-Yes. Did you come to see the[n]stadium too?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Same here. I needed to give myself[n]a pep talk.
Is something wrong?
A pep talk?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sometimes, when things get me down,[n]I come here.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Although, that doesn't really answer[n]your question, does it?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I know this may get in the way of your[n]plans, but would you be willing to join[n]me for lunch?
Kasumi's eyes look a little red and puffy.
It may be best to accompany her...
